title: SDR – Soluções em Tecnologia e Cibersegurança
description:
O Grupo Ivy é um ecossistema completo de soluções de Tecnologia e Cibersegurança, atuando com projetos de alta complexidade, consultoria especializada, Outsourcing, SRE, desenvolvimento de software e um portfólio robusto de serviços em segurança digital, além de uma operação estruturada de revendas e distribuição de soluções corporativas.


Nossa unidade de cibersegurança entrega serviços como Pentest, Pentest Contínuo, Security Champion, Threat Modeling, Treinamentos, Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Governança, incluindo produtos proprietários voltados à evolução contínua da maturidade em segurança, soluções orientadas a risco, escaláveis e integradas aos desafios reais dos ambientes modernos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um SDR para atuar na linha de frente comercial, responsável por gerar oportunidades qualificadas, realizar o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes e construir relacionamentos sólidos com decisores de tecnologia e segurança.

A pessoa ideal tem excelente comunicação, capacidade investigativa, boa desenvoltura ao telefone e experiência comercial no mercado Tech ou Cyber.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto , com possíveis visitas presenciais a clientes quando necessário.
  • Formato de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado .


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa (principalmente por telefone), com foco no ICP da empresa.
  • Conduzir o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes, apresentando a Ivy e entendendo o cenário atual.
  • Qualificar leads avaliando necessidades, dores, maturidade e momento de compra.
  • Manter rotina de acompanhamento e follow-up com leads em diferentes estágios.
  • Registrar informações no CRM, garantindo organização e clareza para o time de vendas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial para priorização de contas e evolução do pipeline.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales, Pré-vendas ou função semelhante em empresas de tecnologia ou cibersegurança.
  • Boa comunicação verbal, especialmente para conversas por telefone.
  • Capacidade de investigação, escuta ativa e entendimento de problemas de tecnologia.
  • Organização para gerenciar conversas, prioridades e registros.
  • Facilidade em criar e manter relacionamentos profissionais.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em consultorias de tecnologia ou segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento geral do mercado de TI ou Cyber (infraestrutura, projetos, serviços, governança, segurança).
  • Experiência em vendas B2B.

Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Organização e consistência
  • Autonomia e proatividade


Se você se identifica com este perfil e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e com forte presença no mercado de tecnologia e cibersegurança, encorajamos você a se candidatar e construir sua trajetória junto ao Grupo Ivy .

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de contratação e soluções em TI, liderando a indústria por meio da entrega de serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo de soluções e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação de infraestruturas tecnológicas.

Possuímos escritórios estrategicamente localizados em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade e inclusão.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a união entre talento, tecnologia e as organizações certas gera resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas ações.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o talento é o que realmente importa.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Analisar requisitos de negócio e desenhar, desenvolver, testar e implementar artefatos de Data Warehouse em Snowflake .
  • Trabalhar diretamente com arquitetos de sistemas para compreender necessidades do negócio e entregar modelos de dados otimizados em Snowflake .
  • Desenvolver integrações com ferramentas de ETL de terceiros , incluindo cenários Cloud-to-Cloud (C2C) e On-Premises-to-Cloud (OP2C) , além de gerenciar pipelines de dados.
  • Administrar e manter pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitHub e Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Realizar análises de performance, query tuning e database tuning em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz em modelos e pipelines, propondo soluções sustentáveis.
  • Desenvolver e seguir boas práticas de codificação, versionamento e governança de dados .
  • Gerenciar e manter integrações entre ADF, Snowflake e ferramentas de terceiros .
  • Interagir com stakeholders e clientes internos para levantamento de requisitos e feedback contínuo .
  • Atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, garantindo organização, qualidade e prazos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com a plataforma Snowflake , incluindo:
  • Arquitetura, processamento e administração
  • Modelagem de dados
  • Roles, databases, schemas
  • Stored Procedures, UDFs
  • Snowpipe, Streams e Shares
  • Experiência com Azure ou outras plataformas de nuvem.
  • Vivência com Data Warehouses corporativos em nível enterprise .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL , incluindo análise de performance e otimização de consultas .
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory (ADF) e integração com Snowflake e ferramentas de terceiros.
  • Experiência com CI/CD , versionamento de código e pipelines utilizando GitHub e Azure DevOps .
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos .
  • Boa gestão de tempo para lidar com múltiplas frentes de trabalho.
  • Excelente comunicação para interação com clientes e times globais.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente , escrito e falado.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência em projetos de Data Analytics de grande porte .
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, Tableau ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados .
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação como Python, Java ou JavaScript .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) .
  • Perfil crítico, analítico e com pensamento fora da caixa.
  • Experiência com testes e preparação de casos de teste .


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: Arquiteto de Software (React Native)
description:
Arquiteto de Software (React Native)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Como Arquiteto de Software, você será responsável por garantir que boas práticas de arquitetura sejam adotadas pelos times de desenvolvimento nos projetos e por criar visões arquiteturais que traduzam necessidades de negócio. Atuará também na comunicação da solução de forma clara ao time técnico, tomando decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos tecnológicos e materializem os objetivos de negócio, sendo responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade nos projetos.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de arquitetura nos projetos;
  • Criar visões arquiteturais que comuniquem a solução de forma clara ao time de desenvolvimento;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em decisões técnicas e estruturais;
  • Tomar decisões que facilitem a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos;
  • Implementar e acompanhar métricas de qualidade;

title: Marketing Technology Lead
description:
Resumo da vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Marketing Technology Lead com sólida experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, para atuar no desenho, implementação e execução de soluções de marketing orientadas a dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por alinhar a tecnologia de marketing às estratégias de Account-Based Marketing (ABM) e B2C , garantindo personalização, automação e integração entre plataformas como Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Estratégia e desenho de soluções: Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, desenhando soluções escaláveis para estratégias ABM e B2C.
  • Arquitetura de dados e personalização: Definir arquitetura de dados, resolução de identidade, segmentação e estratégias de personalização utilizando o Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Automação e jornadas: Construir, gerenciar e otimizar jornadas, automações e experiências personalizadas no Marketing Cloud Next.
  • Execução de campanhas: Executar campanhas ABM e B2C em canais como e-mail, SMS e meios digitais, garantindo consistência e eficiência na comunicação.
  • Integração de sistemas: Assegurar a sincronização e integração de dados entre Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.
  • Análise e otimização: Monitorar performance de campanhas, analisar indicadores de engajamento e conversão, e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaboração com stakeholders: Trabalhar de forma próxima com equipes de marketing, vendas e TI para alinhar tecnologia, processos e objetivos de negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em Marketing Technology: Mais de 5 anos de experiência em tecnologia de marketing, com no mínimo 3 anos de atuação prática em Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Conhecimento em Data Cloud: Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, resolução de identidade e segmentação no Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • ABM e B2C: Experiência com estratégias de Account-Based Marketing e marketing B2C.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Proficiência em SQL, AMPscript, HTML/CSS e fluxos de automação.
  • Capacidade analítica e funcional: Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job description


Location: Remote

Engagement: Part-time (20 hours per week, ongoing collaboration)

Seniority: Mid-level

Language required: Advanced English

Rate: 1.200 USD


The Role


We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to support the continuous evolution of a SaaS product, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked on fintech or financial SaaS platforms .

This is a part-time (20h/week), ongoing role , ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with product and engineering teams, translating complex requirements into clear, user-centered design solutions. As a startup, we value flexibility, autonomy, and a hands-on mindset.


Responsibilities


  • Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI for web-based SaaS products.
  • Improve usability and visual consistency across the platform.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to shape features from concept to delivery.
  • Apply UX thinking to simplify complex, data-heavy or financial interfaces.
  • Maintain and evolve design systems and UI components.
  • Incorporate feedback and iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment.
  • Support marketing initiatives when needed, including visual assets and design for marketing content.


What We’re Looking For


  • Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer working on SaaS products .
  • Strong preference for experience in fintech, finance, or data-heavy platforms .
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, usability, and interaction design.
  • Strong visual design skills with high attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (required).
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly in English .
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in a part-time setup .


Nice to Have


  • Graphic design skills , especially to support marketing content and visual assets.
  • Experience working with early-stage or fast-growing startups.
  • Familiarity with design systems and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience collaborating in remote, distributed teams.

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: Analista de Suporte | Pleno (11825)
description:
Vaga 100% remota


Aqui a gente conecta o mundo.


A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.


Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.


Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.


Conheça + em nosso site:



Qual a missão do Cargo?

Como Analista de Suporte, sua missão é contribuir para a criação de uma experiência fluida, produtiva e agradável para os parceiros que utilizam nossas ferramentas, plataformas ou APIs e o ecossistema Open. O grande desafio deste cargo está em entender profundamente as necessidades técnicas e comportamentais de nossos clientes, identificar pontos de fricção e colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e suporte para propor melhorias contínuas.



Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Realizar a triagem, classificação e acionamento assertivos dos alertas identificados;
  • Realizar a análise de design de APIs e auxiliar os usuários em soluções de negócios e configurações;
  • Construir e analisar códigos Java/ JavaScript;
  • Desenvolver dashboards de negócios;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre as funcionalidades do produto;
  • Testar fluxos de APIs em produção;
  • Debugar o código;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos / processos;
  • Desenvolver automações para procedimentos internos com a plataforma;
  • Evangelizar o uso da plataforma para o cliente / Sensedia;
  • Garantir a boa experiência do usuário em relação a Sensedia (atendimento);
  • Integração com várias áreas da empresa como consultoria, engenharia e customer success;
  • Trabalho em equipe com o time de infraestrutura para ganhar agilidade no atendimento do ticket;
  • Ser parceiro dos nossos clientes.
  • Atender chamados, responder perguntas em canais de comunicação (como e-mail, chats ou fóruns) e acompanhar o atendimento até a resolução completa.
  • Apoiar a criação e atualização de conteúdos técnicos, como FAQs, tutoriais e guias de integração, com base nas principais dúvidas e dificuldades dos usuários.



Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Conhecimento sobre support ao ecossistema Open;
  • Experiência com alguma linguagem de programação e scripts (ex. Java, JavaScript, python, go);
  • Excelente capacidade de análise e troubleshooting a sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos e práticas sobre APIs utilizando padrões de design RestFul (Experiência com integrações entre sistemas é um bom começo);
  • Capacidade de gerir ferramentas e interpretar dados de entrada/saída para diagnóstico de comportamento de sistemas, como forma de identificar problemas (Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Testes Funcionais de APIs (Postman, cURL e SoapUI);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de tickets (Zendesk, Jira, etc);
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva.



Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência prévia com suporte técnico voltado para desenvolvedores ou produtos com APIs.
  • Espanhol|Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita), suficiente para compreender documentações e comunicar-se com desenvolvedores de fora do Brasil.
  • Capacidade de produzir conteúdo técnico (artigos, tutoriais, exemplos de uso) de forma estruturada e didática.
  • Conhecimento em webservices SOAP;
  • Conhecimentos sobre documentação de APIs utilizando OpenAPI Specification (Swagger) e fluxos de negócio;




Aqui você vai encontrar:


  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.


  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.


  • Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Contract Duration: 6 to 12 months

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor / Contract

Work Model: Nearshore – Remote

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)


About the Opportunity

We are a staffing and recruitment consultancy supporting one of our clients with a long-term project. We are seeking a Scrum Master to join a Product & Engineering environment, supporting one to two Scrum teams and contributing to the continuous improvement of Agile practices.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for a professional who is comfortable working with distributed teams and collaborating closely with Agile leadership.


Experience Level

Mid-level (2–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master)


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, ensuring alignment with Agile principles
  • Support and guide one Scrum team, with potential responsibility for a second team
  • Partner with an enterprise Agile Coach to improve team performance and delivery
  • Assist with the implementation and adoption of SAFe practices
  • Identify, escalate, and help remove impediments impacting team progress
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation and feedback
  • Work closely with mid-level managers and cross-functional team members across multiple regions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience as a dedicated Scrum Master
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Scrum of Scrums)
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework); certifications are a strong plus
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and navigate team conflicts
  • Experience working with distributed, global teams


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Adaptability, flexibility, and a proactive attitude
  • Ability to challenge ideas constructively and negotiate pushback when needed
  • Independent thinker with a continuous improvement mindset


Education & Certifications

  • SAFe certification is highly desired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (optional)


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and evolve within Agile frameworks

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A pessoa DevOps Sênior será responsável por garantir a robustez, escalabilidade e segurança da infraestrutura em nuvem, atuando diretamente na automação de pipelines, monitoramento de ambientes e evolução contínua dos processos. Você terá impacto direto na eficiência dos ciclos de desenvolvimento, suportando equipes de engenharia, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos sistemas.


Responsabilidades:

✔ Criar e manter pipelines e automações de deploys (CI/CD), preferencialmente com GitHub Actions

✔ Gerenciar e monitorar clusters Kubernetes, especialmente em GKE

✔ Administrar servidores e ambientes em nuvem (GCP)

✔ Implementar infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform e Helm

✔ Garantir observabilidade com ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus e New Relic

✔ Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento para resolver problemas de performance e infraestrutura

✔ Realizar suporte e troubleshooting de rede, servidores e sistemas


Requisitos:

✔ Formação superior completa

✔ Sólidos conhecimentos em ferramentas de CI/CD (desejável GitHub Actions)

✔ Experiência com containers, Docker e orquestração via Kubernetes (GKE, EKS)

✔ Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Helm)

✔ Conhecimento em scripts (Python, Shell)

✔ Vivência prática com nuvem (GCP, Azure ou AWS)

✔ Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e logs (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic)

✔ Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas

✔ Boa colaboração e trabalho em equipe


Diferenciais:

➕ Certificações em nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure)

➕ Experiência com automações avançadas e GitOps

➕ Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura (DevSecOps)

➕ Experiência com novas práticas SRE


Modelo de trabalho:

title: 11046 - Cientista de Dados
description:
Que tal trabalhar como Cientista de Dados em uma das maiores administradoras de saúde do Brasil?! ✨


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver modelos estatísticos, preditivos e de machine learning para otimização de processos e geração de insights de negócio.

Realizar exploração, limpeza e transformação de grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Criar pipelines de dados e fluxos automatizados para coleta, preparação e versionamento de datasets.

Aplicar técnicas avançadas de analytics, como séries temporais, NLP, clustering, classificação e regressão.

Trabalhar com ferramentas de visualização para apresentar análises e resultados de forma clara e objetiva.

Construir dashboards e relatórios para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Atuar em parceria com squads multidisciplinares (Engenharia, Produto, Negócio, TI).

Desenvolver prova de conceitos (POCs) de modelos e novas soluções analíticas.

Realizar deploy de modelos em produção utilizando boas práticas de MLOps.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Superior completo ou cursando (TI).

Experiência sólida com Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).

Domínio de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais.

Experiência com modelagem estatística e machine learning.

Familiaridade com técnicas de MLOps e versionamento de modelos (MLflow, DVC, etc.).

Conhecimentos sólidos em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados (Big Data).


Diferenciais:

Experiência com NLP, recomendação, visão computacional ou deep learning.

Vivência com cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) e serviços gerenciados de IA/ML.


Contratação: CLT Full + Benefícios

Atuação: 100% Home office

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hello!

We currently have a great job opportunity for you!

About the role:

Role: Data Engineer

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Duration: 6 months

Salary: $ 2200 USD monthly (FTE)


We’re looking for a Data Engineer with backend experience to join a high-impact engineering team building large-scale user-facing products.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and enhance backend features end to end: requirements, implementation, automated testing, A/B testing, and launch validation.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and client teams to deliver complete functionality.
  • Develop reliable, maintainable backend components used by other engineers.
  • Work on large-scale, distributed, and data-intensive systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.
  • Java backend skills (REST APIs, caching, storage, data processing).

description:

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Profissional Back End – .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55483


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de indústria

  • .NET CORE 6, AWS ( required main services) , POSTgreSQL
  • Experiência com inovação aberta, corporate venture, startups ou hubs de inovação.

  • Perfil proativo, comunicativo e com forte senso de propósito e visão estratégica.

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

  • Administração, configuração e troubleshooting de Session Border Controllers (SBC), preferencialmente Audiocodes

  • Interface técnica com clientes, garantindo alto nível de serviço

  • Forte capacidade analítica e experiência em troubleshooting

  • Disponibilidade para plantão 24x7


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com PowerShell
  • Vivência em service desk e atendimento ao cliente
  • Alemão intermediário ou avançado

title: Investment Banking Jr. Associate
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer at Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company), you will join a team of talented AI engineers to implement and deploy AI-driven solutions across various industries. You will be responsible for developing AI strategies, ensuring the successful execution of AI projects, and contribute to the development of AI tools and platforms. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, review and implement AI solution designs, and ensure that Acora remains at the forefront of AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Design & Development :

  • Join teams for development and implementation of AI solutions and systems for clients across various sectors.
  • Propose a broad spectrum of different ideas to complex problems, with the ability to quickly test and iterate to identify the best performing solution
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Cloud Engineering and UI designers and developers to design scalable, cloud-based AI architectures.
  • Stay ahead of the latest AI trends and technologies to continuously improve Acora’s AI offerings.

Client Engagement & Project Delivery :

  • Work with clients to understand their business challenges and objectives, translating them into AI-driven solutions.
  • Be a team player and help to ensure the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and impact.
  • Be able to present AI strategies, solutions, and project outcomes to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
  • Nurture client relationships, whilst building credibility and trust through consistent high-quality delivery.

Operational Excellence :

  • Be part of the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions, ensuring they perform reliably at scale.
  • Develop frameworks and processes to ensure AI models are robust, explainable, and aligned with regulatory standards.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • English is a MUST.
  • Proven experience in AI/ML engineer roles, ideally in consultancy or enterprise environments.
  • Strong expertise in AI/ML algorithms, tools, and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, MCP, Azure AI Foundry, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and cloud-native AI/ML architectures.
  • Understanding of AI/ML model lifecycle management, including explainability, ethics, and fairness in AI.
  • Basic stakeholder management and client-facing experience, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to business leaders.
  • Proficiency in Python, C#, Javascript.
  • Hands-on experience with big data technologies and distributed computing is a plus.


Why Join Elastacloud?

  • Innovative Environment : Work on groundbreaking AI projects that have a real-world impact on industries such as security, finance, and energy. We pride ourselves on innovating through play and games, providing a safe environment to test many ideas and fail fast.
  • Leadership Opportunity : Shape the direction of AI innovation at Elastacloud and make a lasting impact on the business.
  • Collaborative Culture : Join a passionate and driven team that thrives on collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Professional Growth : Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities, with the chance to stay at the cutting edge of AI and cloud technologies.

title: User Acceptance Testing Analyst
description:
Title: UAT Import/Export Lead (LATAM)

Location: Position is 100% remote, candidates needs to be physically sit in the LATAM region

Duration: Initial 8-month contract with extension possibilities.


Key Responsibilities

• Lead or support UAT activities for Import/Export processes, including test planning, execution, and defect management.

• Collaborate with business SMEs and IT teams to ensure test coverage aligns with Client’s global trade compliance and operational requirements.

• Execute test scripts and validate system functionality against business processes.

• Document test results and escalate issues for resolution.

• If required, backfill operational tasks in Import/Export to maintain business continuity during project phases.

• Act as a liaison between IT and business teams, translating technical requirements into business context.

• Ensure compliance with Client’s testing standards and governance.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong Import/Export process expertise, including customs documentation, trade compliance, and shipping requirements.

• Hands-on experience with SAP modules related to global trade and logistics.

• Familiarity with UAT methodologies and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, HP ALM).

• Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Highly Desirable

• Operational experience in consumer goods or manufacturing environments.

• Knowledge of Client’s regional business practices and compliance requirements.

• Local language skills and cultural awareness for effective collaboration.

• Ability to adapt between testing and operational roles as needed.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

title: Service Delivery Manager – Enterprise Support (Remote)
description:
About the company

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.

Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to take ownership of our service operations:

  • SLAs and incident processes
  • on‑call and skills coverage
  • SOPs and first‑line/SRE enablement
  • configuration management
  • SLA metrics and reporting
  • and coordination between customers and our engineering teams.

This is a hands‑on role , not a pure governance role. You will be close to real incidents, engineers, and customers and you’ll be expected to bring in practices you’ve already used successfully in previous service or managed‑services environments.


What you’ll do1. Service operations, on‑call & incidents
  • Design and maintain an on‑call and coverage plan that ensures all critical skills are available when needed (initially weekdays, evolving to full 24/7 where required).
  • Own the incident management process for your accounts: priorities, roles, communication cadence, escalations, and post‑incident reviews.
  • Define and monitor key service metrics (e.g., MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, backlog health) and drive improvements based on them.
  • Act as incident lead / coordinator during major incidents, keeping engineers focused and customers informed.


2. SOPs, runbooks & first‑line enablement
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and triage guides for SRE engineers, covering common incident types and operational tasks.
  • Train and coach first‑line/SRE teams so they can confidently handle initial triage, basic troubleshooting, and clear communication , escalating only when needed.
  • Continuously refine documentation based on real incident experience and feedback.


3. Configuration management & readiness
  • Establish and run a configuration management process that keeps track of each customer’s environment (platforms in use, clusters, regions, configs, access, monitoring, key contacts).
  • Proactively close information gaps by working directly with customers and engineers.
  • Ensure configuration information is available and trustworthy during incidents and for onboarding new engineers.


4. Customer communication & governance
  • Be the primary operational contact for a set of enterprise customers.
  • Lead regular service reviews and status calls , presenting SLA performance, key incidents, risks, and improvement actions.
  • Present and agree on the incident management process with customers (channels, priorities, escalation paths, expectations).
  • Work closely with Account Management / Sales on renewals, expansions, and expectation management.


5. Commercial & delivery management
  • Clarify what is in scope vs. out of scope and work with customers and Sales to shape paid change requests when additional work is needed.
  • Monitor effort vs. contract , help protect margins, and flag risks early (under‑scoped contracts, chronic over‑use, under‑utilized capacity).
  • Work in a matrix environment , coordinating with different technical teams (e.g., database engineering, DevOps, SRE) to staff and deliver engagements effectively.


6. Onboarding & training
  • Design and maintain onboarding paths for new engineers joining support/delivery (shadowing, training on SOPs, environment overviews, “certification” on certain incident types).
  • Ensure new team members reach a productive, independent state quickly and safely.


What success looks like in 6–12 months
  • On‑call coverage is clear, predictable, and sustainable ; engineers know when they’re on and what’s expected.
  • First‑line/SREs handle a meaningful share of incidents without escalation , using well‑maintained runbooks.
  • You can open a customer’s configuration, see an accurate picture, and use it during incidents and planning.
  • SLA and incident metrics are tracked, reported, and discussed regularly with customers and internally.
  • Customers have a clear understanding of how incidents are handled and feel confident in the process.
  • New engineers ramp up faster thanks to structured onboarding and training.


You’ll be a great fit if you have
  • 5+ years in a Service Delivery, Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support role serving external customers (not only internal IT).
  • Experience with 24/7 or extended‑hours operations , including on‑call or follow‑the‑sun setups.
  • Hands‑on experience with incident management and ITSM practices (incident/problem/change), ideally in an ITIL‑inspired environment.
  • A track record of creating or improving SOPs/runbooks and training first‑line / SRE teams.
  • Experience maintaining configuration / environment data for customer systems.
  • Comfort discussing technical topics with engineers (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and explaining them in clear business terms to customers.
  • Experience in commercial delivery : scope boundaries, change requests, effort vs. revenue, working alongside Sales / Account Management.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Background with data, analytics, or streaming platforms (e.g., Druid, Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, ClickHouse, TiDB, Hadoop, cloud data warehouses).
  • Experience working in small, fast‑moving, remote teams.


Location & working style
  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.
  • We are flexible on contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

title: QA Analyst
description:
About TapGoods:


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent.

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers.


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve.


QA Analyst Role:

We are looking for a QA Analyst with a background in both manual and automated testing to join our development team. This role will be primarily responsible for manual testing at first, with an opportunity to shift into automation as we build out our test suite.

We have three web-based products built using Ruby on Rails and React. Our core product is a robust system with many complex features that will require the right person to fully ensure we are releasing the highest quality software.


Responsibilities:

●  Manual testing of new features

●  Manual regression testing of weekly releases

●  Working with the existing QA team on building out automated tests

●  Troubleshooting support issues


Requirements:

●  Experience with manual testing (2+ years)

●  Experience with automated testing (1+ years)

●  A great attitude and work ethic

●  Solution oriented, self-starter, and team player

●  (preferred) Experience in a SaaS company


Experience with the following technologies:

●  HTTP Protocol

●  Diff Tools (Beyond Compare, etc.)

●  Jira

●  Selenium

title: Senior Testing Automation Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Testing Automation Engineer to design and own the overall test strategy, to integrate, implement and maintain end-to-end mobile test suites, to perform some level of manual testing of new features and regression and to define and track quality metrics.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal
  • 5+ years experience on the frameworks Appium and WebdriverIO and language TypeScript
  • Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks (not just writing tests in an existing one)
  • Strong experience with Appium for native iOS and Android apps.
  • Understanding of mobile app architecture (views, navigation, async flows, network calls, permissions, deep links, etc.).
  • Comfortable dealing with emulators/simulators, device farms, app builds, and basic mobile debugging
  • Experience testing REST/GraphQL APIs: auth, error handling, contracts, schema validation
  • Ability to design end-to-end flows that stitch backend + mobile behavior
  • Hands-on experience integrating automation into CI pipelines


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America
