title: Managing Director: Renewables
description:
The Managing Director: Renewables is responsible for building relationships with renewable developers and identifying opportunities to advise on and fund nascent power projects. This role leads a team in sourcing, nurturing, and closing deals for renewable projects, executing capital investments, and managing investor relations. The MD will also collaborate with the company's management to ensure operational compliance and performance.


DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Leadership and Management: Train, lead, and inspire a team of finance professionals.

• Investment Strategy: Develop and execute investment strategies for identifying, evaluating, and acquiring renewable energy projects in targeted global markets.

• Financial Analysis and Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive financial analysis and rigorous due diligence to assess the viability, risks, and returns of potential investments, with a strong emphasis on project portfolio financing and structuring.

• Stakeholder Relationships: Manage relationships with key stakeholders, including project developers, financial institutions, and government agencies.

• Industry Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations, policy changes, and technological advancements in the renewable energy sector to inform investment decisions.

• Portfolio Management: Monitor the performance of renewable energy assets, optimize portfolio performance, and identify opportunities for growth and diversification.

• Negotiations and Deal Execution: Lead negotiations and execute complex financing and transactions for renewable energy projects, with a focus on structuring deals and managing contracts.

• Compliance: Ensure adherence to all relevant regulations and compliance requirements.

• Financial Acumen: Create robust financial modeling and analyses, develop valuation methods, structure financial arrangements, and assess risk management strategies.

• Deep Understanding of Renewable Energy: Drive sustainable growth within the energy sector.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, CFA, CAIA) preferred.

• 8+ years of relevant experience from a Bank or an Asset Management Firm.

• Must be fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese

• Demonstrable experience in renewable project development, investment banking, capital markets, private equity in international and domestic markets.

• Proven experience with private equity investment processes, including deal sourcing, comprehensive due diligence, and investment execution, specifically within renewable energy project portfolios.

• Extensive experience globally in structuring and financing renewable energy projects across various sectors, including solar energy, wind power, biomass, hydroelectricity, and emerging technologies like energy storage and green hydrogen.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a solid understanding of financial concepts and valuation methodologies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex ideas.

• Demonstrated commitment to being trained and developed as a leader, and to training and developing a team with integrity and transparent communication.

• Ability to manage and facilitate multiple projects concurrently.

• Organized with the ability to effectively communicate instructions and requests to the team.

• Exceptional customer service with an investor focus.

• Must be coachable, authentic, easy to work with, and a collaborative team member.

• Must have the grit and agility necessary to thrive in a start-up environment.

• Willingness to train, develop, and support a global leadership team, and effectively work with people of all nationalities, languages, and cultures in a totally remote environment across various time zones.

• Exceptional commitment to integrity, delivering outcomes on time, and resolving breakdowns to meet project promises.

• Passion for and dedication to the transformation of communities on a world scale.

• Demonstrated commitment to the growth and development of the company.

• Ability to travel locally and internationally to various countries, sometimes for extended periods.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️



About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Financial Modelling Analyst
description:
About CELA


CELA – Clean Energy Latin America is a leading financial and strategic advisory firm focused on energy transition in Latin America.


With over 12 years of experience, we advise companies and investors across reflective strategy, energy, fundraising, project finance, and M&A, covering several sector such as Renewables, Hydrogen, Batteries, Biofuels, etc.


Our work supports the development of sustainable energy solutions with real impact across the region.

Learn more:


The Role


We are looking for a Financial Modelling Analyst to join our consulting team and support investment analysis and financial modelling for energy transition projects and companies.

This role offers:

  • Exposure to real investment decisions in renewable energy
  • Direct interaction with clients, investors, and senior consultants
  • A fast-paced, analytical, and impact-driven environment


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and review financial models for: Company and project valuation, Financial due diligence, Feasibility studies and Equity and debt fundraising
  • Analyze operational metrics of energy projects (tariffs, capacity, generation, performance)
  • Evaluate financial indicators, including: Enterprise Value (EV), Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR) and others
  • Support CELA’s consulting team with financial analysis and modelling tools
  • Contribute to high-quality client deliverables and internal decision-making


Profile

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly translate complex financial analyses into actionable insights for clients and internal teams
  • Proactive and comfortable working independently
  • Curious and motivated to develop across energy transition topics
  • Aligned with CELA’s mission to accelerate the energy transition in Latin America


Requirements

  • Previous experience in: Financial modelling, Investment analysis, Corporate finance or valuation
  • Bachelor’s degree in: Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Accounting or related fields
  • Advanced Excel skills (mandatory)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken, mandatory)
  • Full-time availability with exclusivity
  • Availability to work primarily remote (home office)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in renewable energy, energy transition, or power sector
  • Knowledge of Power BI or data visualization tools
  • Background in: Consulting, Investment banking, Project finance, Infrastructure or energy funds


Compensation

  • Competitive, market-aligned compensation
  • Salary negotiable based on experience

title: Investment Banking Analyst
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Estagiário de marketing - SDR e BDR
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OnTrack Agência Digital, atuamos atendendo negócios com ponto físico e lojas virtuais que vendem em todo o Brasil e no Mundo.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Estagiário de Marketing para atuar como SDR (Sales Development Representative) e BDR (Business Development Representative). As atividades incluem a prospecção e qualificação de leads, pesquisa de mercado, suporte na criação de estratégias de marketing e interação direta com potenciais clientes para entender as necessidades e criar oportunidades de vendas. Este é um cargo de 4 a 6h de trabalho diário com atuação 100% remota.


Qualificações (mas dar treinamento também pra quem quer crescer):


  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e persuasiva, com capacidade para interagir eficientemente com clientes e equipes internas.
  • Pesquisa de Mercado: Conhecimento em identificar tendências e analisar dados de mercado para apoiar na prospecção e qualificação de leads.
  • Vendas e Estratégia de Marketing: Experiência ou interesse em vendas e no desenvolvimento de estratégias de marketing que gerem resultados comerciais tangíveis.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Competências voltadas ao suporte ativo ao cliente, garantindo que suas necessidades sejam identificadas e atendidas.
  • É desejável que o candidato esteja cursando Marketing, Administração ou áreas afins, e tenha familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e CRM.


Rotina (4h/dia — segunda a sexta)

1) Planejamento e organização (20–30 min/dia)

  • Revisar metas do dia, respostas pendentes e follow-ups vencidos
  • Selecionar e priorizar leads do dia (perfil ideal de cliente)
  • Atualizar CRM/planilha com “próxima ação” e data

2) Prospecção ativa (1h30/dia)

  • Pesquisar novos leads e iniciar contato (WhatsApp/Instagram/LinkedIn/e-mail)
  • Enviar mensagens de primeiro contato com personalização mínima (1 linha)
  • Registrar cada contato no CRM

3) Follow-ups e respostas (1h30/dia)

  • Executar follow-ups estruturados (D+1, D+3, D+7 e D+14)
  • Responder conversas abertas e conduzir o lead para qualificação
  • Confirmar interesse, dor e momento do negócio

4) Qualificação rápida + agendamento (30–40 min/dia)

  • Fazer perguntas objetivas (dor, objetivo, momento e capacidade de investimento)
  • Agendar reunião e enviar link + confirmação (data/hora)


Metas (jornada de 4h/dia)

Metas diárias (média):

  • 30 a 50 primeiros contatos enviados
  • 20 a 40 follow-ups realizados
  • 1 a 2 reuniões agendadas (média diária, variando conforme o dia)

Metas semanais (segunda a sexta):

  • 150 a 250 primeiros contatos enviados
  • 100 a 180 follow-ups realizados
  • 4 a 8 reuniões agendadas
  • 3 a 6 reuniões realizadas (comparecimento)


Remuneração
  • Salário fixo: R$ 600,00
  • Bônus por reunião agendada e qualificada: R$ 30,00 por reunião
  • Bônus por contrato fechado: R$ 150,00 por contrato
O bônus por contrato fechado é pago mesmo que o SDR não participe das etapas finais de reunião ou negociação , desde que o lead tenha sido originado e corretamente qualificado pelo SDR.
Terá um plano de carreira para te desenvolver como vendedor e a depender do teu esforço e dos resultados entregues, poder crescer rapidamente dentro da agência.

title: Senior Researcher
description:
We are currently seeking Editorial Board Members for “Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders”

We are seeking experienced researchers and scientists to join us as Editorial Board Members for the journal, "Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders”

About the Role:

Actively contribute to the development and growth of the journal by providing valuable scholarly input, including the selection of topics, reviewers, and authors.

Contribute/solicit Special Thematic Issues on a trending topic (one thematic issue every year).

Review articles submitted to the journal (at least thrice a year) in your area of expertise.


Requirements:

Scientist or researcher (PhD) with experience in Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders in clinical, medical, and pharmaceutical research, and related subject areas.

At least 5 years of experience in peer-reviewing, editing, and writing research papers.

Verifiable record of publications in peer-reviewed journals indexed in WOS Core Collection and/or Scopus.

Ability to communicate clearly and timely with stakeholders in the English language.


Benefits:

Save APCs on publishing your research

As an Editorial Board Member, you will be entitled to publish your papers and thematic issues, free of cost.


Keep tabs on the latest research

Editorial Board Members will be able to access and review new research/review papers as they are submitted to the journal, allowing them to keep abreast of the latest trends in Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders in clinical, medical, and pharmaceutical research, and related subject areas.


Network with a community of scholars

You will be able to connect with professionals, scholars, and experts on our editorial board, opening new opportunities to collaborate on novel research projects and broaden your perspective in the field.


About the Journal:

Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders is an international, peer-reviewed, multi-disciplinary journal for physicians, clinicians, and scientists with an interest in glucose and lipid metabolic disorders in pathological processes, as well as the therapeutics targeting these disorders to treat human diseases.

Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders publishes original research articles, guidelines, reviews, and commentaries on a broad range of topics. The journal is particularly interested in manuscripts that address important advances in glucolipid metabolomics and the clinical application of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism. Areas of interest cover, but are not limited to:

• Clinical applications of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism to improve patient care and outcomes

• Clinical trials illustrating the use of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism

• Conceptual characterization of glucolipid metabolic disorders

• Mechanisms of glucolipid metabolic disorders in diseases

• Metabolomics of glucose and lipids

• Methodologies & preclinical and clinical applications of glucolipid metabolomics

• Novel techniques & approaches for the advancement of glucolipid metabolomics

• Translational research in glucolipid metabolomics


Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders is an international, peer-reviewed journal on all aspects of glucolipid metabolomics, published continuously (print & online) by Bentham Science Publishers.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: QA Analyst
description:
About TapGoods:


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent.

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. title: Senior Researcher
description:
We are currently seeking Editorial Board Members for “Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders”

We are seeking experienced researchers and scientists to join us as Editorial Board Members for the journal, "Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders”

About the Role:

Actively contribute to the development and growth of the journal by providing valuable scholarly input, including the selection of topics, reviewers, and authors.

Contribute/solicit Special Thematic Issues on a trending topic (one thematic issue every year).

Review articles submitted to the journal (at least thrice a year) in your area of expertise.


Requirements:

Scientist or researcher (PhD) with experience in Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders in clinical, medical, and pharmaceutical research, and related subject areas.

At least 5 years of experience in peer-reviewing, editing, and writing research papers.

Verifiable record of publications in peer-reviewed journals indexed in WOS Core Collection and/or Scopus.

Ability to communicate clearly and timely with stakeholders in the English language.


Benefits:

Save APCs on publishing your research

As an Editorial Board Member, you will be entitled to publish your papers and thematic issues, free of cost.


Keep tabs on the latest research

Editorial Board Members will be able to access and review new research/review papers as they are submitted to the journal, allowing them to keep abreast of the latest trends in Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders in clinical, medical, and pharmaceutical research, and related subject areas.


Network with a community of scholars

You will be able to connect with professionals, scholars, and experts on our editorial board, opening new opportunities to collaborate on novel research projects and broaden your perspective in the field.


About the Journal:

Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders is an international, peer-reviewed, multi-disciplinary journal for physicians, clinicians, and scientists with an interest in glucose and lipid metabolic disorders in pathological processes, as well as the therapeutics targeting these disorders to treat human diseases.

Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders publishes original research articles, guidelines, reviews, and commentaries on a broad range of topics. The journal is particularly interested in manuscripts that address important advances in glucolipid metabolomics and the clinical application of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism. Areas of interest cover, but are not limited to:

• Clinical applications of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism to improve patient care and outcomes

• Clinical trials illustrating the use of targeting glucose and lipid metabolism

• Conceptual characterization of glucolipid metabolic disorders

• Mechanisms of glucolipid metabolic disorders in diseases

• Metabolomics of glucose and lipids

• Methodologies & preclinical and clinical applications of glucolipid metabolomics

• Novel techniques & approaches for the advancement of glucolipid metabolomics

• Translational research in glucolipid metabolomics


Glucolipid Metabolic Disorders is an international, peer-reviewed journal on all aspects of glucolipid metabolomics, published continuously (print & online) by Bentham Science Publishers.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;

title: Investment Banking Analyst
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js + Terraform)
description:
About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • Professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript.
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Professional experience with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .
  • English proficiency for professional communication.


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Engenheiro de DevSecOps "#988183"
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão. Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps com foco em segurança e automação.
  • Arquitetar e operar serviços Azure, incluindo AKS e soluções cloud nativas usando IaC.
  • Garantir confiabilidade, monitoramento, observabilidade e segurança das aplicações.
  • Atuar como referência em automação e DevOps, apoiando times ágeis e melhorias contínuas.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência em projetar, implementar e dar suporte a práticas e ferramentas DevSecOps.
  • Experiência com AKS
  • Experiência com Azure
  • Experiência com CI/CD


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Managing Director: Renewables
description:
The Managing Director: Renewables is responsible for building relationships with renewable developers and identifying opportunities to advise on and fund nascent power projects. This role leads a team in sourcing, nurturing, and closing deals for renewable projects, executing capital investments, and managing investor relations. The MD will also collaborate with the company's management to ensure operational compliance and performance.


DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Leadership and Management: Train, lead, and inspire a team of finance professionals.

• Investment Strategy: Develop and execute investment strategies for identifying, evaluating, and acquiring renewable energy projects in targeted global markets.

• Financial Analysis and Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive financial analysis and rigorous due diligence to assess the viability, risks, and returns of potential investments, with a strong emphasis on project portfolio financing and structuring.

• Stakeholder Relationships: Manage relationships with key stakeholders, including project developers, financial institutions, and government agencies.

• Industry Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations, policy changes, and technological advancements in the renewable energy sector to inform investment decisions.

• Portfolio Management: Monitor the performance of renewable energy assets, optimize portfolio performance, and identify opportunities for growth and diversification.

• Negotiations and Deal Execution: Lead negotiations and execute complex financing and transactions for renewable energy projects, with a focus on structuring deals and managing contracts.

• Compliance: Ensure adherence to all relevant regulations and compliance requirements.

• Financial Acumen: Create robust financial modeling and analyses, develop valuation methods, structure financial arrangements, and assess risk management strategies.

• Deep Understanding of Renewable Energy: Drive sustainable growth within the energy sector.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, CFA, CAIA) preferred.

• 8+ years of relevant experience from a Bank or an Asset Management Firm.

• Must be fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese

• Demonstrable experience in renewable project development, investment banking, capital markets, private equity in international and domestic markets.

• Proven experience with private equity investment processes, including deal sourcing, comprehensive due diligence, and investment execution, specifically within renewable energy project portfolios.

• Extensive experience globally in structuring and financing renewable energy projects across various sectors, including solar energy, wind power, biomass, hydroelectricity, and emerging technologies like energy storage and green hydrogen.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a solid understanding of financial concepts and valuation methodologies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex ideas.

• Demonstrated commitment to being trained and developed as a leader, and to training and developing a team with integrity and transparent communication.

• Ability to manage and facilitate multiple projects concurrently.

• Organized with the ability to effectively communicate instructions and requests to the team.

• Exceptional customer service with an investor focus.

• Must be coachable, authentic, easy to work with, and a collaborative team member.

• Must have the grit and agility necessary to thrive in a start-up environment.

• Willingness to train, develop, and support a global leadership team, and effectively work with people of all nationalities, languages, and cultures in a totally remote environment across various time zones.

• Exceptional commitment to integrity, delivering outcomes on time, and resolving breakdowns to meet project promises.

• Passion for and dedication to the transformation of communities on a world scale.

• Demonstrated commitment to the growth and development of the company.

• Ability to travel locally and internationally to various countries, sometimes for extended periods.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

title: Investment Banking Jr. Associate
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Gerente Sr Tecnologia (Engenharia)
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  • Liderar times de engenharia de software, atuando de forma próxima às pessoas e garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia de negócio, execução técnica e entrega de valor.
  • Desenvolver e gerir líderes técnicos e engenheiros, promovendo crescimento profissional, engajamento, empatia e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro.
  • Garantir a eficiência do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software, desde o planejamento até a entrega e sustentação.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar métricas de engenharia como burn down, burn up, velocidade, lead time, throughput e qualidade de entrega, utilizando dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Atuar na priorização de demandas junto às áreas de produto e negócio, equilibrando capacidade do time, prazos, riscos e valor entregue.
  • Assegurar a adoção de processos ágeis de forma pragmática, integrados a modelos clássicos de gestão, governança e previsibilidade.
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais e técnicas, mantendo proximidade com o time e garantindo padrões de qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Promover melhoria contínua nos processos, práticas de engenharia, qualidade de código e cultura de entrega.
  • Gerenciar conflitos, riscos e mudanças organizacionais com resiliência, clareza e responsabilidade.
  • Atuar como elo entre engenharia, produto, operações, dados e liderança executiva.

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de pessoas e liderança de times de engenharia, com comunicação clara, empática e assertiva.

Billing Systems integrations

Product & Price Rules

Bundles & Configuration Attributes

MDQ & Quote Templates

Pricing logic and dependency modeling

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️



About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and
